channel.description: Recent content in Contact & Support on ITJ Labs Department

item.title: Workshop – Mastering Transformers with Hugging Face and LangChain
item.description: This advanced hands-on workshop guided participants through mastering Transformers using Hugging Face and LangChain. The session covered prompt templates, chaining logic, inference workflows, and real-world deployment considerations for LLM-based applications.

item.title: Tech Talk – Understanding Transformers in Modern AI
item.description: In this Tech Talk hosted by miCoach, we explored the foundation of transformer-based architectures such as BERT and GPT, including self-attention mechanisms, token embeddings, and how they enable breakthroughs in language modeling and beyond.

item.title: Bootcamp – Build and Train CNNs with PyTorch
item.description: We led a practical bootcamp with miCoach on building and training convolutional neural networks (CNNs) using PyTorch. Participants gained hands-on experience creating custom models for image classification, and explored transfer learning techniques.

item.title: Foro Mujer Actual 2025 – Innovation Panel
item.description: Our team was represented in the 15th Foro Mujer Actual, participating in the Innovation Panel with other women leaders in celebration of International Women’s Day and the magazine’s 18th anniversary.

item.title: Multiclass Evaluation of Vision Transformers for Industrial Welding Defect Detection
item.description: This study evaluates Vision Transformers (ViTs) on the Aluminum 5083 TIG dataset for both binary defect detection and multiclass categorization, achieving 98–99% accuracy—far surpassing prior CNN-based models.

item.title: Bootcamp – Practical Deep Learning with PyTorch
item.description: In this practical bootcamp, we guided participants through the foundations of deep learning using PyTorch — covering tensors, training loops, model design, and real-world applications.

item.title: UABC Business Intelligence Talk
item.description: Invited talk as part of the Business Intelligence Conference Series organized by UABC, promoting student engagement in professional development.

item.title: Workshop – Efficient Image Classification using CNNs
item.description: Hands-on workshop at CONISOFT 2024 covering CNN fundamentals, model building with PyTorch, and transfer learning techniques using MobileNet and ResNet for efficient image classification.

item.title: NEO 2024 – Vision Transformers for Industrial Defect Detection
item.description: We presented our research on Vision Transformers for industrial defect detection at NEO 2024, highlighting multiclass classification accuracy and its application to quality control in manufacturing.

item.title: Seminar on Artificial Intelligence and Quantum Computing
item.description: We participated as guest speakers in CITEDI-IPN’s Seminar on Artificial Intelligence and Quantum Computing, sharing insights on real-world AI research, QML, and emerging applications.

item.title: Tech Talk – Deep Understanding of Deep Learning
item.description: We hosted a technical session for the miCoach community, explaining how deep learning models work under the hood — from linear algebra intuition to CNNs and Transformers.

item.title: Lobby Empresarial – Cybersecurity & AI in Industry
item.description: Our team was represented at CETYS Universidad’s Lobby Empresarial panel on Cybersecurity and AI, where experts from academia and industry discussed current challenges and opportunities in the digital transformation of enterprises.
